landing.heroSubtitle: Recall turns your conversations with Claude into active recall: it explains a topic, makes you recall it from memory, and tracks how much you retain over time.
landing.step1Body: In Claude Desktop, Claude explains a topic and saves its table of contents as the source of truth — before you say a word.
landing.step2Body: It asks «what do you remember?» and you answer with no hints. Active recall is what cements learning into long-term memory.
landing.step3Body: Claude evaluates and scores each subsection; the dashboard shows you what you've mastered and what to review, with spaced repetition.
landing.feature1Title: Subsections as the source of truth
landing.feature1Body: What was explained is saved before your recall, so the evaluation measures what you actually covered — not how it felt in the moment.
landing.feature2Body: The system computes when each topic comes due and builds your review sessions by urgency. You review right before you forget.
landing.feature3Body: Each subsection is conceptual or practical. Concepts get explained; practice puts you to solving exercises — programming, math, anything.
landing.feature4Body: Organize topics into groups (Python, Operating Systems, Math…) and review one group or everything. Optional adaptive difficulty.
landing.ctaBody: Create your account, connect Claude Desktop, and let the system keep track of your memory.
